acceptance_guidance: Measure installed force and acceleration complex transfer, including ATI analog AA damping and ADXL intrinsic electronics/mechanics, over the bump band and all relevant loaded modes; identify each path.

Use simultaneous channels and common hardware trigger; calibrate all strain channels to force before reconstruction. Match effective force/acceleration transfer causally and validate residual mismatch against mS*acceleration amplitude.

At100kraw and10kcontrol, capture current frame, process force matrix/filters/projection/PI, and update winding-current request with a measured0–20us target. Stress50us pipeline as engineering bound, not a datasheet guarantee.

Apply the engineered2pole AA to the ADXL path; ATI already contains an AA response and must not receive an unaccounted duplicate2pole analog filter. The native common path represents one effective matched response per sensor.
ADC approximately0.65us conversion provision is only conversion, not data read/compute/output time. Do not infer the complete deterministic path from it.
Measure electronics noise,200kclock feedthrough/alias, mounted21k response, sanding vibration and rectification. Broadband white ENBW sizing does not certify those narrowband artifacts.
Retain physical sensor raw range, scale/cross-axis/bias calibration and mass/gravity compensation; matching filters does not eliminate those errors.
Retain equal-RMS force-noise distribution sensitivity; the native bounded-uniform force source is not evidence of Gaussian-tail margin.

Align measured head position and issued-robot predictor kinematics to the same effective acquisition frame as S acceleration; count their own delays and do not filter already conditioned acceleration twice. The40Hz head-motion observer has its separate causal direction-estimation response.

primary_sources.checked: 25 ug/sqrt(Hz) typical ADXL1002, +/-50 g, 40 mV/g at 5 V, 4.7 kHz 5% band, 11 kHz response gain-rise definition, 21 kHz mechanical resonance; external band limiting and installed mounting are required.

Eight simultaneous channels, 0-5 V supported. Analog input filter 25 kHz with 6.8 us phase delay in low-bandwidth mode; 220 kHz/1.1 us general high-bandwidth, 150 kHz/1.5 us in 0-5 V. Oversampling adds conversion/filter latency. Table3 tCONV extracted values 0.5 and 0.65 us; typ/max column attribution not relied upon here.

DAQ six bridge outputs are amplified and conditioned, then matrix-converted after digitizing; DAQ anti-alias is two-pole 5.1 kHz. TWE supplies no built-in conditioning/AA and requires customer electronics. Tooling affects sensor mechanical response.
